requirements.evidence: Connectors: connector:0#-1,0|0,0 (left pair), connector:0#1,0|2,0 (right pair), connector:0#0,0|1,0 (bridge between pairs) — all kind side-connector-double; no joint bolts or other connectors present

finish.summary: Four full hex bases in a straight line (-1,0 to 2,0) capped on all open faces. Left pair (-1,0|0,0) and right pair (1,0|2,0) each joined internally by a side-connector-double, and the two pairs bridged only by a central side-connector-double (0,0|1,0). No joint bolts or alternative join hardware; check_build clear.

lines.key: pvc-section-double  (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
